items.title: 8.3 Designing Applications for Pakistan Using Emerging Technologies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 8.3: the text before its first sub-heading (PDF 115, printed 111).

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing aur Blockchain jaisi emerging technologies Pakistan ke fauri masail hal karne ke naye mauqe deti hain (Figure 8.6). Nayi ijaad ko maqami samajh ke saath mila kar talaba aisi applications bana sakte hain jo zindagiyan behtar karein, paidawar (productivity) barhayein aur paidar tarakki (sustainable development) mein madad dein. Zimmedari aur takhleeqi soch se use hon to yeh technologies sehat, taleem, zaraat aur hukmrani (governance) jaise shobe badal sakti hain.

blocks.alt: Pakistan ka saada naqsha (map), sooba (province) har aik alag rang mein: Balochistan, Sindh, Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa aur shumali ilaqe; shumal mashriq ke kinare par dashed line jis par 'Frontier undefined' likha hai. Naqshe ke gird technology ke nishan: shumal maghrib mein AI chip aur doctor (sehat), shumal ke oopar IoT ka badal, aur mashriq mein badal (cloud computing), khuli kitab (taleem) aur jure hue blocks ka jaal (blockchain).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.6: Emerging technologies zaraat, sehat aur hukmrani jaise shobon mein Pakistan ke masail hal kar sakti hain (kitab ki Figure 8.6 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Nishan dikhate hain ke nayi technologies (AI, IoT, cloud computing aur blockchain) aur woh shobe jinhein yeh madad de sakti hain (jaise sehat aur taleem) poore Pakistan mein kaam aa sakte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh figure Pakistan ka naqsha hai jis ke gird technology ke nishan bane hain: AI (masnoi zehanat), IoT (internet se jure aalat), cloud (internet par data aur programs), aur blockchain (jure hue blocks ka record). Doctor ka nishan sehat aur kitab ka nishan taleem ko dikhata hai. Matlab: yeh technologies Pakistan ke har hisse mein sehat, taleem, zaraat aur hukmrani ke masail hal karne mein madad de sakti hain.

blocks.prompt: Figure 8.6 ke mutabiq emerging technologies Pakistan ke kin shobon (sectors) mein masail hal kar sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: Zaraat (agriculture), sehat (health) aur governance; text taleem (education) ka bhi zikr karta hai.

items: AI, IoT, Cloud aur Blockchain Pakistan ke masail ke naye hal de sakte hain.
Healthcare, taleem, zaraat aur governance badal sakte hain, agar zimmedari aur creativity se use hon.
